'''KE4-N4''' was an [[Astromech droid]] that flew alongside [[Lieutenant]] [[Callahan]] in [[Callahan's E-wing|her]] [[E-wing starfighter]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Part One" />

==History==
===Patrolling Lothal===
[[File:KE4-N4.png|thumb|left|200px|KE4-N4 in 9 ABY]]
KE4-N4 was assigned to [[Lieutenant]] [[Callahan]]'s [[Callahan's E-wing|E-wing starfighter]] on the planet of Lothal. When [[Sabine Wren]] missed the [[Spectres mural ceremony]], Callahan along with [[Captain]] [[Porter]] intercepted the veteran [[Mandalorian]] driving away on her [[Speeder bike]]. Callahan attempted to stop her, only for Wren to go under her E-wing, causing KE4-N4 to blow a gasket.<ref name="Part One" />

==Behind the scenes==
KE4-N4 first appeared in the [[Part One: Master and Apprentice|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part One" /> which released on [[August 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Part One Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref> The [[droid]] remained unidentified when the episode aired, but received a name in [[Callahan]]'s databank entry on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|lieutenant-callahan|Lieutenant Callahan}}</ref> The droid's head is reminiscent of the distinctive screen-inaccurate design of the original [[R2-D2]] [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|action figure]] released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1978]].<ref>[https://galacticfigures.com/figureDetails.aspx?id=1996 Galacticfigures.com Kenner R2-D2]</ref>
